long_biography.plain_text:
At Meta, Mark Zuckerberg retains direct responsibility for company direction, product strategy and core technology. His role has kept him involved in the design of the services and infrastructure that succeeded Facebook's original social network, while the organisation expanded into a broader technology group.

Zuckerberg has applied a parallel engineering emphasis through the Chan Zuckerberg Initiative, which he co-founded with Priscilla Chan. Its Biohub network brings scientists, engineers and AI specialists together to create tools for studying cells, disease and basic human biology. The programme treats technical infrastructure as a shared resource for biomedical discovery.
long_biography.html:
At Meta, Mark Zuckerberg retains direct responsibility for company direction, product strategy and core technology. His role has kept him involved in the design of the services and infrastructure that succeeded Facebook's original social network, while the organisation expanded into a broader technology group.

Zuckerberg has applied a parallel engineering emphasis through the Chan Zuckerberg Initiative, which he co-founded with Priscilla Chan. Its Biohub network brings scientists, engineers and AI specialists together to create tools for studying cells, disease and basic human biology. The programme treats technical infrastructure as a shared resource for biomedical discovery.
